2  HC-KAR  THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAJESH RAI K  ORAL ORDER
There is no representation for the petitioners even on the second call.
This petition is filed in the year 2024.
The office has raised objections and the matter is posted today for counsel's submission with regard to office objection No.1.
Despite there is no representation.
Hence, it could be presumed that the petitioners are not interested in prosecuting the matter.
Hence, the petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
